known: Core problem: Airbnb hosts with 1-5 properties face a related cluster of problems around turnover & property operations — e.g. cleaner turnover coordination, supply restocking tracking, welcome book contents unclear.

Evidence on file: Restocking supplies and consumables is easy to forget.
Evidence on file: Editable welcome-book/template tools fail to save or print, losing hosts' work.

Existing paid solutions with real sales AND recurring complaints (gap)
